units.spine: The Free Elder Council asks the households here and almost nothing it asks for arrives.
A traveller says a matter taken to the Free Elder Council comes back unsettled, and the same matter put to somebody with no title is settled the same day.

units.poolKey: no token matched: unclassified (the plain-description floor)
units.spine: Warmholz is governed by the Free Elder Council, and nothing here is settled anywhere else.

units.poolKey: governing faction holds a DOMINANT share
units.spine: No other interest here weighs against the Free Elder Council, and the households it consults know how little the consulting counts.

units.poolKey: capture pressure ADVANCING (weak security, poor prosperity)
units.spine: The pressure to buy a say here is working inward, on the older heads and not on the road, and a place with nobody paid to keep order and little enough to go round is cheap to buy into. Nobody here has been bought: nobody yet.
Anyone in the hamlet can say who cares about what, and a matter goes to whoever cares about it. Nobody here belongs to a camp.
The older heads here come round to a matter before the Free Elder Council settles it, and what is settled stays settled.

units.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
units.spine: A pedlar says a stranger who calls the Free Elder Council by any other name is corrected at once and politely.
The people of the place see the Free Elder Council govern and are no longer sure the governing is the Council's to do.

units.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public rejection is breaking the hold
units.spine: What the Free Elder Council has lost here it has lost to the households and not to a rival.
